request.style: English, solemn male baritone solo, acoustic guitar, piano, cello, soft strings, reflective, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The son of Melea, the son of Menna
The son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan
A name held tight in the royal chain
A link within the blood and rain

[Verse]
When your days are done and you rest
With your fathers in the dust and west
I will raise up your offspring near
From your own body, clear and dear

[Verse]
He is the one who builds a house
For my name, without a single doubt
I will establish his throne
In the garden of the bone and stone

[Verse]
I will be a father to him
And he shall be a son to him
When he does wrong, I will discipline
With the rod of men, with a human line

[Verse]
But my steadfast love will never depart
As I took it from Saul, my heart
Your house and kingdom endure before
Your throne is established once and for ever

[Outro]
The son of Adam, the son of God
